## Goal

Design and run a fresh observation experiment on lab instrument error codes as a new domain for the view-count principle, following D083

## Summary

Designed and ran fresh observation experiment E100 on industrial automation/SCADA fault codes domain (forum.inductiveautomation.com). Measured view-count principle generalization: G1 PASS (21 vc_positive items), G2 PASS (100% control accuracy), G3 FAIL (76.2% unserved fraction, CI95 [54.9%, 89.4%] - markedly higher than embedded 15.3% and non-software Discourse 11.7%), G4 PASS (100% view_positive_rate). The view_count instrument generalizes to a 7th platform type (industrial automation Discourse), but the unserved fraction reveals domain variation. No candidate produced; evidence-gathering per D083.

## Next
